input.description: Check and build the open-ports extension
Install the open-ports extension into Pilot

delta.text:
I made an "Open Ports" list extension and installed it. It lists the TCP ports this Mac is listening on, with the program and PID for each; Return copies the port.

To open it, type "Open Ports" in Hyper+Space and filter by port or program.

It was made in `/tmp/pilot-ext/demo/open-ports`, a Raycast extension: it runs in Raycast too (`npm install && npm run dev` there).
